title: Where bidri has been made
description: A map of the towns where bidri is or was made, from Bidar and Hyderabad today to the eighteenth- and nineteenth-century courts of Purnia, Murshidabad and Lucknow, placed by their Wikidata coordinates.

u0001.text: By the nineteenth century bidri was also worked at Purnia, Murshidabad and Lucknow.

u0002.text: Bidar and Hyderabad are named as the chief centres of bidri today.

C006.text: Bidar and Hyderabad are named as the chief, and in one account the only, present-day centres of bidri production.

quotes.quote: Bidar remains one of the chief centres of bidriware production in the country, alongside Hyderabad in present-day Telangana.
Today, Bidri is produced only in two centres in India: Bidar and Hyderabad.

C025.text: By the late eighteenth century bidri had spread to the courts of Purnia and Murshidabad, and by the nineteenth century to Lucknow.

quotes.quote: By the late eighteenth century, the technique had spread to the Muslim courts of Purnia (in present-day Bihar) and Murshidabad (in present-day Bengal), and by the nineteenth century, to Lucknow (in present-day Uttar Pradesh).
